description: goo 2026-07-28: Calendar Phase 0 (data/state/routing skeleton, NO UI, NO network). This is a LOGIC seam, not pixels, so the teeth are on the pure logic, not a screenshot. Bug-classes the anchor owns: (1) SAVE-FLOW double-commit/replay latch (the PR#97 client-side-effect class) — a second commit while saving must be a NO-OP so exactly one reminder is written, never two; the transition TABLE encodes this as data (saving has no commit edge) not just code, and lost-response stays saving (never a silent success). (2) 0-APP-FETCH matcher correctness for assertNoAppFetch — it hooks page.on(request) NOT response (a request to a downed /api emits no response = a response-level check reads 0 app-fetch while a fetch left the page = vacuous pass, the Zone-3 class), and it must NOT false-flag NextAuth /api/auth/* framework infra (which fires on every v2 page and needs no backend) or a 0-network page could never go green. (3) dayCellTier thresholds (DESIGN.md Good>=60/Medium40-59/Bad<40) and (4) menu-state contract (FormMode has no Mate AI). verify-the-instrument 2-way. Teeth (mutation-proven, npx tsx scripts/calendar-phase0.test.ts): baseline 18/18 pass; mut-A add a commit edge to saving in the transition table (double-write) -> double-commit-latch + no-self-write tests CAUGHT (16/18); mut-B remove the /api/auth framework exclusion (false-flag infra) -> NextAuth-not-app-fetch test CAUGHT (15/18); both reverted, back to 18/18. gate_layer=logic/state-machine.
